moneyline.market: Moneyline (model alone vs de-vigged closing line)

spread.market: Spread (model alone vs 50/50 at the closing spread)
spread.baseline: a coin flip at the closing spread

total.market: Total (model alone vs 50/50 at the closing total)
total.baseline: a coin flip at the closing total

h1_total.market: 1st half total (line = market total x league 1H share)
h1_total.baseline: the hit rate of that line over the same games (hindsight constant)

h2_total.market: 2nd half total incl. OT (line = market total x league 2H share)
h2_total.baseline: the hit rate of that line over the same games (hindsight constant)

fg_over0.5.baseline: the league hit rate over the same games (hindsight constant)

fg_over1.5.baseline: the league hit rate over the same games (hindsight constant)

fg_over2.5.baseline: the league hit rate over the same games (hindsight constant)

qb_yards.market: QB passing yards (line = his recent average)
qb_yards.baseline: a coin flip at the quarterback's recent average

qb_td_over0.5.baseline: a Poisson at the quarterback's recent touchdown rate

qb_td_over1.5.baseline: a Poisson at the quarterback's recent touchdown rate

qb_td_over2.5.baseline: a Poisson at the quarterback's recent touchdown rate

anytime_td.baseline: each player's own recent touchdown rate
